title: Settings
pin_first: This needs your parents' PIN. There isn't one yet. It's set below under “For parents”.

contact.question: May Buddy text your phone?
contact.answer_on: Yes. Buddy may also text your phone.
contact.answer_off: No. Buddy only writes to you here in the app.
contact.answer_paused: Taking a break – up to and including {{date}}.
contact.explain_off: For example when a test is coming up. Never at night.
contact.push_off_server: Right now LearnBuddy doesn't send anything to phones, though. Everything arrives here in the app.
contact.allowed_no_device: Allowed. This phone couldn't be registered, though. You'll find Buddy's messages here in the app.
contact.stopped: Switched off. Planned messages won't be sent.
contact.minor_hint: Allowing more needs your parents' PIN. Less is always possible.
contact.no_pin_hint: For that, your parents first set a PIN below.
contact.pause_hint: During a break nothing is sent to your phone.
contact.window_hint: When Buddy gets in touch unprompted, it's at this time.
contact.per_week_hint: This counts when Buddy gets in touch unprompted. Reminders you agreed on still arrive.
contact.device_no_token: This phone isn't registered yet. Until then everything arrives here in the app only.
contact.device_invalid: The registered phone can no longer be reached. So everything arrives here in the app only.
contact.device_not_possible: That isn't possible on this phone right now. Maybe notifications are off in the system settings.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.level_question: Where are you learning right now?
profile.grade_hint: Buddy pitches the questions to it.

adult.intro_minor: This is where parents manage the account. Some things need the PIN.

pin.title: Parents' PIN
pin.body: With the PIN, parents allow things like Buddy texting the phone. The child shouldn't know it.
pin.current_hint: Forgotten? Then leave this empty. You'll confirm with your password instead.
pin.mismatch: The two PINs aren't the same.
pin.reason_pin_required: The current PIN is missing or not right. You can also confirm with your password.
pin.reason_reauth_required: Please confirm with your password. That way only an adult can set the PIN.
pin.no_email: The e-mail address isn't stored on this phone. Please sign out and in again once.

export.title: Export data
export.body: Everything that is stored, as text. To keep or pass on.
export.share_failed: Sharing didn't work. Please try again.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Everything is deleted for good after 7 days. Until then you can cancel it.
delete.scheduled: Deletion is scheduled: from {{date}} at {{time}}. Until then you can cancel it.
delete.cancelled: Deletion cancelled. Everything stays as it was.
delete.confirm_body: In 7 days everything is deleted for good: account, profile, conversations, photos and practice. Until then you can cancel it here.

signout.title: Sign out
signout.confirm_body: Signing in again needs the e-mail address and the password.

status.title: Is everything working?
status.model_false: Not right now. Practising still works.
status.push_no_token: No. No phone is registered. Everything arrives here in the app.
status.push_disabled: No. This is switched off at LearnBuddy right now. Everything arrives here in the app.
status.push_invalid: No. The registered phone can no longer be reached. Everything arrives here in the app.
status.scheduler_question: Is Buddy working in the background?
status.scheduler_ok: Yes. Even when the app is closed.
status.scheduler_stale: Not right now. Reminders may be late.
